name: Genuine Service - Amazon Courier Asking for Delivery OTP (English)

caller_script.text: Hello sir, I am calling from Amazon delivery. I am standing outside your building gate with your parcel.
Sir, this package is prepaid but requires a delivery OTP. An Amazon SMS with 4 digits was sent to your phone, please share it so I can mark it delivered.
No problem sir, you can check your SMS or I can hand the package to your society security guard if you give him the code.
